name: Roblox: Captain Bristlejaw
summary: Most walruses never stray from their cozy patch of sea ice, but there's no floe in the seven seas that can keep ol' Bristlejaw from open waters. He's faced down krakens, gales, pirates, cabin fever, and more stale ship's biscuits than you can shake a belaying pin at. And does he complain? Well, yes. But like any good sailor, he saves all his grumbling for when the seas are smooth and the harbor's in view. Get Captain Bristlejaw when you sign up for Roblox on PlayStation Plus.
